name: Nhat Le riverbank
kicker: Morning walk on the Nhật Lệ
summary: Walk the Nhật Lệ in the morning, with boats on the water and coconuts on the Bảo Ninh bank. The bridge in these frames is the older span, begun in June 2002, 635 m by 12 m with 15 spans. It is not the single-tower Nhật Lệ 2. No promenade fee was printed. The time on the path is check on arrival.
getThere: Walk from a riverside room, the market, or the beach. Minutes between them are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The older Nhật Lệ bridge, palms, and the far bank

notice.title: This bridge is not Nhật Lệ 2
notice.body: The span in the photographs is the older Nhật Lệ bridge from 2002. Nhật Lệ 2 is the single A-tower the ward page describes, and this page has no photograph of the whole tower.

body: The ward page starts the day on the river path, looking across to Bảo Ninh, then toward the mouth. Boats use the water. Coconuts mark the far bank. The market, the Mother Suốt statue, and the bridges sit on the same walk. Early is the hour that page names.

Do not merge the two bridges. A visitor note describes Cầu Nhật Lệ as 635 m long, 12 m wide, 15 spans, begun in June 2002 and finished two years later. That is the multi-span bridge in these frames. Nhật Lệ 2, on the ward page, is one A-tower, two spans of 150 m, and a tower of 98 m, lit at night. No photograph here shows that whole tower, so it is not a sight card.
No promenade fee was printed. The time on the path is check on arrival. A closing hour for the bank was not printed either.

figures.caption: Boats and coconut palms on the Nhật Lệ
figures.alt: Boats on the Nhật Lệ with coconut palms along the bank

gettingThere: Both banks run through the center. Walk from a room by the market or from the beach. The ward page treats this as the ordinary morning. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the market
legs.body: Walk along the left bank. Chợ Đồng Hới is on Mẹ Suốt, beside the river. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Nhật Lệ beach
legs.body: Walk toward the mouth and back along the bank. The ward page puts the beach in the city. Minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No closing hour for the path is published. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: No promenade fee was printed on the ward page. Check on arrival.
